genericPageProvider.name: recent_documents
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:uuid IN (?) AND ecm:isTrashed = 0

genericPageProvider.name: document_versions
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:versionVersionableId = ? AND ecm:isVersion = 1

genericPageProvider.name: document_publications
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:isProxy = 1 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0 AND (rend:sourceVersionableId = ? OR ecm:proxyVersionableId = ?)

genericPageProvider.name: downloaded_documents
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:uuid IN (?)

genericPageProvider.name: document_distribution
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:mixinType != 'HiddenInNavigation' AND ecm:isProxy = 0 AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0 AND ecm:path STARTSWITH ?

genericPageProvider.name: nxql_default_search
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:mixinType != 'HiddenInNavigation' AND ecm:isProxy = 0 AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0

genericPageProvider.name: path_children
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:parentId = ? AND ecm:mixinType = 'Folderish' AND ecm:mixinType != 'HiddenInNavigation' AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0 AND ecm:name ILIKE ?

genericPageProvider.name: entity_permissions
genericPageProvider.pattern: SELECT * FROM Document WHERE ecm:mixinType != 'HiddenInNavigation' AND ecm:isProxy = 0 AND ecm:isVersion = 0 AND ecm:isTrashed = 0 AND ecm:acl/*1/principal = ?
